verdict.rationale: x402 is an open protocol with an open-source SDK (npm x402 package, Linux Foundation governance), and the protocol's own author states 'anyone can self-host the same mechanics on any network, with any token/crypto asset,' confirming self-hosting is technically possible outside Coinbase's hosted CDP Facilitator. However, all first-party docs describe usage of the hosted CDP Facilitator (validation, screening, settlement, discovery via Bazaar) rather than providing a step-by-step self-hosting guide for running your own facilitator/discovery stack. Missing for 10: official self-hosting documentation/tutorial for running a facilitator independently, and evidence of production self-hosted deployments outside Coinbase's infrastructure.
